verdict.rationale: Live probes show Supabase serves an llms.txt at supabase.com/llms.txt that points to a single-file full documentation, and the Auth guide is available as agent-friendly markdown (auth.md). An OpenAPI spec is also served, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or endorsing the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and confirmation of the full content of llms-full (the probe output is truncated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://supabase.com/llms.txt # Supabase Docs
For the complete documentation in a single file, see [Full Documentation]
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth.md # Auth
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://supabase.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
